records.jp: 香織！
records.en_original: Kaori!
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori!
records.en: Kaori!

records.jp: あ！　日菜子！<CR>いきなり声掛けないでよ！　びっくりするじゃない！
records.en_original: Ah! Hinako! Don't call out all of a sudden like that! You surprised me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! Hinako! Don't call out all of a sudden like that! You gave me a shock!
records.en: Ah! Hinako!<CR>Don't call out to me so suddenly! You startled me!

records.jp: ごめん……。<CR>それで、またゲーム？
records.en_original: Sorry... Are you playing a game again?
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry! Are you playing a game again?
records.en: Sorry...<CR>So, are you playing another game?

records.jp: ううん。今ちょうどコスプレイヤーの画像見てたの
records.en_original: Nope. I was just looking at photos of cosplayers.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. I was just looking at photos of cosplayers.
records.en: Nope. I was just looking at photos of cosplayers.

records.jp: え！？　香織コスプレに興味があるの？
records.en_original: What!? Are you into cosplay?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! Are you into cosplay?
records.en: What!? Are you into cosplay?

records.jp: うん……最近ちょっとね……
records.en_original: Yeah... A bit, lately...
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. A bit, lately.
records.en: Yeah... A bit, lately...

records.jp: どうしてまたコスプレに……？
records.en_original: Why the sudden interest?
records.en_auxiliary: Why the sudden interest?
records.en: Why the sudden interest?

records.jp: あたしもともと洋服が好きでいろんな種類試してたんだけど……
records.en_original: I've always liked clothes, so I try on all kinds of different styles.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always liked clothes, so I try on all kinds of different styles.
records.en: I've always liked clothes, so I've tried all kinds of styles...

records.jp: 試しすぎて飽きちゃったから、<CR>ネットでいろんな服調べてたんだ……
records.en_original: But after trying a little bit of everything, I got bored, so I started looking at other clothing online...
records.en_auxiliary: But after trying a little bit of everything, I got bored, so I started looking at other stuff online.
records.en: But I tried so many that I got bored,<CR>so I started looking up all kinds of clothes online...

records.jp: そしたら、コスプレイヤーの画像が目にとまってね……<CR>それで興味持ったからどんなのがあるかいろいろ調べてたの……
records.en_original: Then I just happened to see pictures of cosplayers... I got interested, and started researching what kinds there were.
records.en_auxiliary: Then I stumbled across pictures of cosplayers. I got interested and started researching what kinds there were.
records.en: Then pictures of cosplayers caught my eye...<CR>I got interested, so I started looking into what kinds there were...

records.jp: へえ、香織はいろんなことに興味をもつんだね……
records.en_original: Huh, it sounds like there's a lot you're interested in.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, it sounds like there's a lot you're interested in.
records.en: Huh. You take an interest in all kinds of things, Kaori...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: あっ！　そうだ！
records.en_original: Oh! Right!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! Right!
records.en: Oh! Right!

records.jp: 日菜子は原種と戦う時だけじゃなくて、<CR>コモンでもコスプレみたいな衣装着てるんでしょ？
records.en_original: You're always cosplaying in the Common, not just when fighting Sephirot, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You're always cosplaying in the Common! Not just when fighting Sephira, right?
records.en: You wear an outfit like a cosplay costume in the Common too,<CR>not just when you're fighting Sephira, right?

records.jp: （コスプレって……）
records.en_original: (Cosplay...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Cosplaying?)
records.en: (Cosplay...?)

records.jp: リフレクターの衣装のこと？
records.en_original: Do you mean my Reflector outfit?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you mean my Reflector outfit?
records.en: Do you mean my Reflector outfit?

records.jp: そう！　それっ！
records.en_original: Yeah! That!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! That!
records.en: Yeah! That!

records.jp: 着てる時ってどんな感じ？　恥ずかしかった？
records.en_original: How does it feel when you're wearing that? Is it embarrassing?
records.en_auxiliary: How does it feel when you're wearing that? Is it embarrassing?
records.en: How does it feel when you're wearing that? Is it embarrassing?

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: ごめん……あんまり意識してなかった……
records.en_original: Sorry... I've never really thought about it.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry. I've never really thought about it.
records.en: Sorry... I never really thought about it...

records.jp: そう……残念……
records.en_original: I see... That's a bummer...
records.en_auxiliary: I see. Ah, well...
records.en: I see... That's a bummer...

records.jp: でも、いつもと違う自分になったように感じるよ……
records.en_original: But I do feel like I'm a different me than usual...
records.en_auxiliary: But I do feel like I'm a different me than usual.
records.en: But I do feel like I've become a different version of myself...

records.jp: やっぱり。そうなんだ……
records.en_original: I thought you might. Interesting...
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you might. Interesting.
records.en: I thought you might. Interesting...

records.jp: うん。だから、香織が新しい自分を体験してみたいと思ってるなら<CR>コスプレしてみるのもいいと思うよ
records.en_original: Yeah. So if you want to try being a different you, maybe you should try cosplaying.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. So if you want to try being a different you, maybe you should try cosplaying.
records.en: Yeah. So if you want to experience a new side of yourself,<CR>I think trying cosplay might be a good idea.

records.jp: うーん……１回やってみようかな……<CR>近所の友達も喜んでくれると思うし……
records.en_original: Hmm... I guess I could give it a try, at least once. My neighborhood friends might like it, too...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I guess I could give it a shot, at least once. My neighborhood friends might like it, too.
records.en: Hmm... Maybe I'll try it once...<CR>I think my neighborhood friends would enjoy it too...

records.jp: え！？　いきなり見せるの？
records.en_original: What!? You'd actually show other people?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! You'd actually show other people?
records.en: What!? You'd show it to them right away?

records.jp: うん。<CR>だって、人に見てもらうまでがコスプレでしょ
records.en_original: Yeah. Isn't that kind of the point?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Isn't that kind of the point?
records.en: Yeah.<CR>Cosplay isn't complete until someone sees it, right?

records.jp: （そうなのかな……）
records.en_original: (I don't know...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't know.)
records.en: (Is that how it works...?)

records.jp: そうと決まれば、まずは衣装を買わないと！<CR>日菜子感想ありがとう……
records.en_original: Okay, I like this idea. I need to buy a costume! Thanks for your thoughts, Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, I like this idea. I need to buy a costume! Thanks for your thoughts, Hinako.
records.en: Then first I need to buy a costume!<CR>Thanks for the advice, Hinako...

records.jp: それじゃ
records.en_original: See you later.
records.en_auxiliary: See you later.
records.en: See you later.

records.jp: 行っちゃった……
records.en_original: She just left...
records.en_auxiliary: She just left...
records.en: She just left...

records.jp: やっぱり違う自分になったように感じるよ……
records.en_original: I feel like I become a different me...
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I become a different me...
records.en: I really do feel like I've become a different version of myself...

records.jp: なんか制服着てる時と違っていろんなことができる<CR>気がするし
records.en_original: Like I can do things I can't do while wearing my uniform.
records.en_auxiliary: Like I can do things I can't do while wearing my uniform.
records.en: It feels like I can do all kinds of things<CR>I can't do while I'm wearing my uniform.

records.jp: ……そう……。<CR>あたしもコスプレすればそんなふうに感じられるかな？
records.en_original: ...Interesting... I wonder if I'd feel the same way if I tried cosplaying?
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder... I wonder if I'd feel the same way if I tried cosplaying?
records.en: ...I see...<CR>I wonder if cosplay would make me feel that way too?

records.jp: 多分、好きなキャラの衣装着れば<CR>誰でもそういう感覚になれると思う……
records.en_original: I'm pretty sure anyone would feel that way they wore the costume of a character they liked...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm pretty sure anyone would feel that way if they wore the costume of a character they liked.
records.en: I think anyone could feel that way<CR>if they wore a costume of a character they like...

records.jp: ……よしっ！<CR>あたし、コスプレやるよ！
records.en_original: ...Okay, then! I'll give cosplay a try!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, then! I'll give cosplay a try!
records.en: ...All right!<CR>I'm going to try cosplay!

records.jp: それで近所の友達に見せて喜んでもらう
records.en_original: I'll show all my friends in the neighborhood, too. I'm sure that'll make them happy!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll show all my friends in the neighborhood, too. I'm sure that'll make them happy!
records.en: Then I'll show it to my neighborhood friends and make them happy.

records.jp: い、いきなりそれはハードル高いんじゃ……<CR>まずは自分の部屋で一人の時の方が……
records.en_original: Th-That seems like a pretty high bar for your first time... Maybe you should try it alone in your room, first...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that seems like a pretty high bar for your first time. Maybe you should try it alone in your room first.
records.en: I-Isn't that a pretty high bar for your first time...?<CR>Maybe you should start alone in your room...

records.jp: 大丈夫！　あたし、いろんな洋服着てたし何とかなるって！
records.en_original: It'll be fine! I've worn all kinds of clothes, it'll work out!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fine! I've worn all kinds of clothes. It'll work out!
records.en: It'll be fine! I've worn all kinds of clothes, so I'll manage!

records.jp: それじゃ、あたし今から衣装買いに行くから<CR>バイバイ日菜子
records.en_original: Anyway, I'm going to go buy a costume now. Bye bye, Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, I'm going to go buy a costume now. Bye bye, Hinako!
records.en: Then I'm going to buy a costume right now.<CR>Bye, Hinako.

records.jp: （大丈夫かな……）
records.en_original: (Will she really be okay...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Will she really be okay?)
records.en: (Will she really be okay...?)
